# BAD-018 — Announcements phase 2: coach-mark product walkthroughs

## Brief
From BadTakes TODO.md item 44 (added 2026-08-26). Announcements phase 1 shipped the pipeline and three surfaces (modal, toast, badge). The anchor registry in renderer/announce.js already maps names to elements and badges use it, so a server can point at a control without knowing the DOM, and an older client skips an anchor it does not have.

What is left for walkthroughs:
- private.announcement_steps: ordered steps, each with an anchor, body_md and an asset.
- Activate 'walkthrough' in the kind check. It is reserved there since 0032 and nothing writes it. LIVE_KINDS in server/supabase/functions/_shared/announce.mjs (modal, toast, badge as of 2026-09-14) is what keeps a v1 client from being served one.
- A coach-mark positioning layer with next, back and skip.
- Also deferred from phase 1: a "What's new" row in Settings that replays the last digest on demand.

Watch the badge-anchor CSS when adding hosts: the entry row avoids overflow hidden so the focus ring survives, and a clipped dot is a badge that silently never appears.

Read first: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-26-in-app-announcements-design.md, section "Phase 2 — walkthroughs". Server half follows the server-changes skill; the web app and desktop both render announcements, so check both surfaces.
